python_rext.source: JUnit XML per suite, parsed — never grepped from piped runner stdout (the v1.11 incident-#6 buffer-fragility class)
python_rext.invocation_note: one invocation per suite, rc captured into a variable each time, never off a pipe
python_rext.delta_note: M255 close reported 1505 passed over a THREE-suite scope (stack-core + demo-stack + stack-injection). Same-scope comparison for M256 is 1552 passed (1723 - 171 stack-verify), i.e. +47. The four-suite figure is not comparable to M255's headline and is not presented as such.
python_rext.collection_trap: a bare `pytest` from the demo-stack section root collects the ephemeral platform clones under stacks/ and exits rc 2 on ModuleNotFoundError. The suite must be scoped to tests/. Recorded because it reads as a failing suite.

go_rext_test_funcs.source: git grep -E '^func Test' -- '*_test.go', excluding platform clones under stacks/

go_modules.note: rext is NOT one Go module — `go test ./...` from the rext root FAILS BY DESIGN. Each section carries its own go.mod and must be run individually.

close_review.refuted_detail: looksLikeCurrentPosition reported dead by two independent reviewers (false — grep was silently skipping the file that exercises it); and a proposed onboarding count fix that would have conflated the curated and manifest denominators.

defect_class.name: checks that report success without having checked
defect_class.yield_shape: FLAT — 6/11/9 across three passes. A flat yield does not mean nearly done; it means the seam is broad, which is why the cap was accepted as un-stabilized with residuals enumerated rather than declared exhausted.
defect_class.fences_detail: the liveness fence counted not.toBeVisible() as proof the page was alive; the bounded-interaction fence never scanned the retry loop it is named after

deferrals.keep_deferred_note: each is a ROADMAP decision rather than a routing one and awaits the user's signature; assigning this fate to a batch to clear the gate is the move the audit exists to catch

notes: Tooling + docs only; zero platform-repo edits held. The milestone's deliverable is a sharpened Playthrough suite: 18 -> 30 live Playthroughs, mutating 1 -> 12, negative controls 0 -> 28 of 30, blocked outcomes 0 -> 1, written verdicts 31/31 with 0 unimplementable, and two whole products (org-admin, onboarding) that no e2e suite had ever touched. The close's own highest-value finding is about measurement rather than code: a raw NUL byte made a 43 KB / 79-test file BINARY to grep, which then reported no matches with no error — and two independent reviewers concluded from that silence that a predicate the file exercises was dead code. Every 'nothing references this, so it is dead' conclusion in this project rests on grep reporting honestly.
